無次元の核座標と規格化した1電子角。3固定刻み、2架空質量、1固定seedのOU熱浴です。 自作模型の無次元単位。Q,時間,電子角,温度を固定し、M=20、架空角質量μ=.04/.01。cp.xのemass規約とは別です。 編集上の補足 長時間第一原理NVE、一般の多軌道直交制約・SCF誤差、電子/核の一般熱浴、正準平衡・断熱分離・エルゴード性、実物質は未検証。 採用した計算法 short nuclear thermostat coupling Compare a normalized two-state electronic degree of freedom coupled to a nuclear coordinate, short NVE and one nuclear OU bath. Registry and counting notes These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Results and verificationMethods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Actual coupled normalized electronic angle and nuclear coordinate, short NVE plus one nuclear OU trajectory. No first-principles/long NVE/canonical sampling/production CPMD. BO and mu.04 state comparisons use fixed4096/8192 RK4 companions; mu.01 receives energy checks only. Authored dimensionless model units with M=20 and angular fictitious mass mu=.04/.01; these are not cp.x emass units. Editorial clarification Long first-principles NVE, general multi-orbital orthonormality/SCF errors, general electronic/nuclear baths, canonical equilibration, adiabatic/ergodic certification and materials remain unverified. Adopted numerical method Use analytic BO forces and the declared CP-type action with Verlet/BAOAB; record nuclear heat and fictitious electronic kinetic energy separately.
